verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community report that Ollama has shipped ROCm containers since version 0.1.27, and the user says they run it on an AMD GPU. That suggests first-party container images exist, but nothing in the pack documents running the runtime in a container. Missing for 10: first-party docs on an official container image and how to run it, coverage of GPU variants beyond ROCm (e.g. CUDA/CPU), guidance on reproducible deployment (version pinning, model persistence via volumes), and broader hands-on corroboration.
